name: telegram-channel
description: Talk with Gideon in Telegram. Use separate conversation topics, exchange voice notes and files, receive scheduled updates, and approve actions from your chat.
author: Gideon

x-meta.label: BotFather token
x-meta.help: Create your bot in Telegram with @BotFather. Hosted tokens are stored in Connections.

x-meta.label: Your Telegram user ID
x-meta.help: Your numeric Telegram user ID. Generate a pairing code above and send it to your bot. Only the paired owner approves actions and answers interactive questions.

x-meta.label: Default notification chat
x-meta.help: Optional paired DM or tracked group ID.

x-meta.label: Allowed topics
x-meta.help: Optional comma-separated chat_id:topic_id list. Empty allows all topics in tracked groups.

x-meta.label: Use the root DM as a lobby
Show connection status on bot profile
Streaming transport
x-meta.help: edit, auto, draft, or off

x-meta.label: Notification mode
x-meta.help: important or all; silent notifications overrides both

x-meta.label: Fallback API addresses
x-meta.help: Optional comma-separated public IPv4 addresses; Telegram TLS identity remains verified

x-meta.label: Permanent DM topics
x-meta.help: JSON list: [{"chat_id":123,"topics":[{"name":"Research","skill":"skill-id"}]}]

x-meta.label: Forum topic skills
x-meta.help: JSON object keyed by chat_id:topic_id, values {"skill":"skill-id"}

x-meta.label: Channel instructions
x-meta.help: JSON object keyed by chat_id, topic_id, or chat_id:topic_id; topic instructions override group instructions

x-meta.label: Additional mention patterns
x-meta.help: JSON list of case-insensitive regular expressions; invalid or expensive patterns are skipped.

x-meta.label: Ignored topics
x-meta.help: JSON list of chat_id:topic_id identifiers

x-meta.label: DM command administrators
x-meta.help: JSON list of user IDs; paired owner remains an administrator

x-meta.label: Group command administrators
x-meta.help: JSON list of user IDs

x-meta.label: Commands for other DM users
x-meta.help: JSON list of command names without /

x-meta.label: Commands for other group users
x-meta.help: JSON list of command names without /

x-meta.label: Additional allowed users
x-meta.help: JSON list of user IDs for DMs and groups. * opens access to everyone

x-meta.label: Additional group users
x-meta.help: JSON list of user IDs allowed only in groups

x-meta.label: Additional allowed groups
x-meta.help: JSON list of group IDs. Every member may converse; * allows all groups

x-meta.label: Update transport
x-meta.help: polling or webhook

x-meta.label: Public webhook URL
x-meta.help: Hosted setup: POST /gideon/v1/telegram/webhook/setup while signed in, then use the returned path on your Gideon domain.

x-meta.label: Webhook verification secret
x-meta.help: Store the secret_token returned by hosted webhook setup in Connections. Renew before its returned expiry.

x-meta.label: Default notification topic
x-meta.help: Set with /sethome inside your Telegram topic.

x-meta.label: Command menu ordering
x-meta.help: JSON with max_commands (1–100), priority (command names), priority_mode (prepend or append).

x-meta.label: Ignore messages addressed to other bots
Additional bots
x-meta.help: Encrypted JSON list. Each bot needs bot_token and may override owner_id and other Telegram settings. Bots have separate conversations and topics. Enabled here controls all bots.

x-meta.label: Per-bot preferences
x-meta.help: JSON preferences for additional bots; updated automatically by their voice and home commands.
